author: Dess811
quote: I don’t like that they’ve turned GTA 6 into "The Sims 5". I was expecting an action game—intense shootouts, chaos, and variety. But the game’s hyper-realism has killed all the fun. Why would I want to deal with mundane, everyday tasks in a game? Why force me to develop a relationship with Lucia in an action game? If I wanted to play a dating sim, I’d choose a different game. GTA 6 is even slower than *RDR 2*! It’s just unacceptable. I get that some people might enjoy this new direction, but this isn’t GTA anymore—it’s something else entirely. They don’t even really let you steal cars properly. It’s absurd. 30 fps with drops to 22-25 in 2026 is so bad!!!
